Definition
[Bounded linear functional and dual space] 1. appD:D.3-def-6\group Functional Analysis (i) A bounded linear operator $u^*:X\to \mathbb R$ is a bounded linear functional.

(ii) The dual space $X^*$ is the space of all bounded linear functionals on $X$.
